title: Mestre-Tramador-GitHub-Labels
description: This schema determines the rules for JSON|YAML|TOML parsing of the reference of the GitHub labels used by Mestre-Tramador.

^\\$schema$.$comment: This only is enabled so JSON files doesn't need to allow comments and can be straight up referenced to this schema.

labels.description: The list of labels is composed solely of labels.
labels.$comment: The uniqueness of the labels names must be checked programmatically.

label.description: A GitHub label is mandatorily composed of a name and a color, with an additional description.

labelColor.description: Hexadecimal code of the label color.

labelDescription.description: A helpful description of the meaning of this label.
